mapper.sql: select query_id, query_name, query_desc, public_code, status, source_file, sheet_name, row_count, access_pwd, view_count, search_count, parse_status, parse_msg, need_captcha, daily_limit, create_user_id, dept_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, null::varchar as owner_name, null::varchar as owner_nick_name, start_time, end_time, publish_at, remind_hours, remind_sent, remind_mail from biz_query

select q.query_id, q.query_name, q.query_desc, q.public_code, q.status, q.source_file, q.sheet_name, q.row_count, q.access_pwd, q.view_count, q.search_count, q.parse_status, q.parse_msg, q.need_captcha, q.daily_limit, q.create_user_id, q.dept_id, q.create_by, q.create_time, q.update_by, q.update_time, q.remark, u.user_name as owner_name, u.nick_name as owner_nick_name, q.start_time, q.end_time, q.publish_at, q.remind_hours, q.remind_sent, q.remind_mail from biz_query q left join sys_user u on u.user_id = q.create_user_id
mapper.insert: insert into biz_query ( query_name, query_desc, public_code, status, source_file, sheet_name, row_count, access_pwd, view_count, search_count, parse_status, parse_msg, need_captcha, daily_limit, create_user_id, dept_id, create_by, create_time, remark, start_time, end_time, publish_at, remind_hours, remind_sent, remind_mail ) values ( #{queryName}, #{queryDesc}, #{publicCode}, #{status}, #{sourceFile}, #{sheetName}, #{rowCount}, #{accessPwd}, #{viewCount}, #{searchCount}, #{parseStatus}, #{parseMsg}, coalesce(#{needCaptcha}, '0'), coalesce(#{dailyLimit}, 0), #{createUserId}, #{deptId}, #{createBy}, now(), #{remark}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{publishAt}, coalesce(#{remindHours}, 24), coalesce(#{remindSent}, '0'), coalesce(#{remindMail}, '0') )
mapper.select: where status = '0' and publish_at is not null and publish_at <= now() order by publish_at asc limit 100
where status = '1' and end_time is not null and end_time <= now() order by end_time asc limit 100

where status = '1' and end_time is not null and coalesce(remind_hours, 0) > 0 and coalesce(remind_sent, '0') = '0' and end_time > now() and end_time <= now() + (coalesce(remind_hours, 24) || ' hours')::interval order by end_time asc limit 100
mapper.delete: delete from biz_query where query_id in #{id}
mapper.update: update biz_query set view_count = coalesce(view_count, 0) + 1, update_time = now() where query_id = #{queryId}
update biz_query set search_count = coalesce(search_count, 0) + 1, update_time = now() where query_id = #{queryId}
update biz_query set create_user_id = #{createUserId}, dept_id = #{deptId}, create_by = #{createBy}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where query_id = #{queryId}
